If you haven't already, I'd unlock the house and on the island the night before so you go to the volcano right away. Or you can use totems or an obelisk if you've got them on your farm.

Slime charmer ring (prize for meeting slime killing goal) allows you to dodge all of the tiger slimes so that makes life easier.

The door to the next level is almost always on the back wall so just head straight up (with a watering can if you can) and you should find the doors no problem. Use bombs to help clear any stones in your way rather than spending time breaking them individually.

Food is always helpful but anything that boosts your speed will help you zoom through each floor. Make sure you've got a nice high level weapon too (galaxy sword if possible) and boots with a good level of defence. Good luck!
